responsibility: Defines the HP-UX 10.10-specific `-munix=95` option variant for the PA port. It maps that option to the shared `flag_pa_unix` setting used by HP-UX CPP and link specs, enabling selection of the UNIX 95 predefined environment and startup files on this OS level.
same_name_distinction: HP-UX 10.10 option definition file: unlike pa-hpux1010.h, it only introduces munix=95 by setting flag_pa_unix to 1995, leaving the actual startup-file and target-macro behavior to the header.
